title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a/ KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval a Firm Transportation Agreement with Addison Gilbert Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disalosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 01-22)
